environment.description: Same Quarkus 2.16 handler deployed on OpenShift 4.13 Serverless (Knative) with pod security admission set to 'restricted' profile. The pod spec includes securityContext with allowPrivilegeEscalation=false and a seccomp profile of RuntimeDefault. Container capabilities are explicitly dropped via spec.containers[0].securityContext.capabilities.drop containing CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN. The Knative service revision template also specifies resource limits of 256Mi memory. Additionally, the cluster runs CRI-O 1.26 with a custom seccomp profile that blocks the execve family of syscalls for containers in the 'serverless-restricted' namespace.
